title: Why |a × b| is an area
back: Base $\lvert\vec a\rvert$, height $\lvert\vec b\rvert\sin\theta$: area of the parallelogram $=\lvert\vec a\rvert\lvert\vec b\rvert\sin\theta=\lvert\vec a\times\vec b\rvert$. A triangle on the same sides is half of it.

title: Magnitude of a vector
legend: a_1, a_2, a_3 = components along the axes
back: Vector joining $P$ to $Q$: $\vec{PQ}$ = position vector of $Q$ − position vector of $P$.

title: Unit vector
back: Divide by your own size. A vector of magnitude $m$ in the direction of $\vec a$ is $m\hat a$.

title: Section formula (internal, m : n)
legend: a, b = position vectors of the end points A and B
back: $m$ multiplies the far end $\vec b$. Mid-point: $\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b}{2}$. External division: replace $n$ by $-n$.

title: Dot product
back: A scalar. $\vec a\cdot\vec a=\lvert\vec a\rvert^2$. $\hat i\cdot\hat i=1$, $\hat i\cdot\hat j=0$.

title: Angle between two vectors
back: Perpendicular vectors: $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. This is how you find an unknown $\lambda$.

title: Projection of a on b
back: Divide by the magnitude of the vector you are projecting **on**. It is a scalar.

title: Square of a sum
tex: |\vec a+\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2+2\,\vec a\cdot\vec b+|\vec b|^2
back: The tool for "$\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec0$" and "$\lvert\vec a+\vec b\rvert=\lvert\vec a-\vec b\rvert$" questions (the second gives $\vec a\perp\vec b$).

title: Cross product
back: A vector perpendicular to both. $\vec a\times\vec b=-\vec b\times\vec a$; $\hat i\times\hat j=\hat k$; $\vec a\times\vec a=\vec0$.

title: Areas from the cross product
back: With diagonals $\vec d_1$, $\vec d_2$ of a parallelogram: area $=\dfrac12\lvert\vec d_1\times\vec d_2\rvert$.

title: Unit vector perpendicular to a and b
back: Two answers (both signs) unless the question fixes the direction.

title: Lagrange's identity
tex: |\vec a\times\vec b|^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2
back: Because $\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1$. Gives $\lvert\vec a\times\vec b\rvert$ from $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ in one line.
